sources: Fox News reporting (senior US officials), via The Statesman (no declared tier) and Gulf News (T3); Times Now and Moneycontrol relays (no declared tier)
fault_line: Strike now or talk? The Nov 9 moonless window is closing in while a Qatar-mediated proposal sits on the table -- does Trump take the opening or take the deal?

sections.what_happened: [ATTRIBUTED REPORT -- Fox News, citing senior US officials, via Statesman/Gulf News] Trump held national security meetings on Wednesday and Thursday on whether to resume large-scale military operations against Iran; Axios (via Moneycontrol/Times Now) says Thursday's session was the first such meeting since the Nov 3 midterm elections. CENTCOM is completing preparations for a possible offensive but has NOT received a new directive from Washington. Trump is weighing three options: fresh strikes, continued economic pressure, or a negotiated settlement requiring major Iranian concessions. [FOX NEWS OBSERVATION, NOT AN OFFICIAL DEADLINE] Fox News noted November 9 marks a new moon in the Middle East (minimal/no moonlight), an environmental condition considered highly advantageous for military operations; officials have NOT publicly identified Nov 9 as a deadline. [RESTATED CONTEXT, already recorded at 0300-01] Trump, Oval Office Thu: 'Now we will make a decision... I would rather not destroy the rest of the country, if possible, but maybe I will have to. You will know soon enough.' One watch-item for escalation: a third US carrier strike group -- USS Theodore Roosevelt is on a Singapore port call from Friday and is not expected to reach CENTCOM's area before mid-November (Axios via Moneycontrol/Times Now).
sections.what_verified: 1 tiered family: Gulf News (T3, relay). Fox News is the origin of the meetings/new-moon report and has NO declared tier in the registry, so it cannot count toward corroboration; The Statesman, Times Now and Moneycontrol relays also carry no declared tier. The Oval Office quote itself is confirmed (recorded 0300-01); the meetings and the Nov 9 framing rest on the single-origin Fox News report.
sections.what_disputed: No White House or Pentagon statement confirms the Wed/Thu meetings' content or any decision timeline; no official has named Nov 9 as a deadline -- the new-moon framing is Fox News's, not the administration's. Diplomacy continues in parallel: Iran submitted a nuclear proposal via Qatar (Reuters, recorded 0100-01) and Araghchi held calls with Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, UAE, Oman and Egypt on Thursday. Trump has repeatedly predicted imminent deals that did not materialise (noted by NDTV/Al Jazeera on the Ukraine file). The Roosevelt's mid-November ETA means a third carrier group is not yet in theatre.
sections.why_matters: New element only: the meetings happened Wed+Thu, CENTCOM is ready but has no order -- and Fox News is flagging Nov 9, the new moon, as the window. Production must NOT re-narrate the Oval Office quote (recorded 0300-01); the story is the timing marker.
